author: Muse (port)
Cryptid team (original mod)
description: 175 Jokers and 28 consumables ported from Cryptid by the Cryptid team (SpectralPack), including the Epic, Exotic, Candy and Cursed rarities, the Bulwark and UltPair poker hands, the Code and Unique consumable types, and registered Green/Azure seals, Astral/Mosaic/M editions and Cat/Double M/Rework tags. Requires the Balatro3DS fork's Tier 1 + Tier 2 + Tier 3 mod APIs (create/destroy cards, retrigger returns, SMODS.Rarity, SMODS.PokerHand, SMODS.ConsumableType, SMODS.Seal/Edition/Tag, Joker-targeting consumables, e_mult/e_chips/x_chips/balance returns) and its Wave 1 systems (G.jokers_sold, the game_over context, joker_type_destroyed) and its Wave 5 systems (SMODS.copy_joker, SMODS.blueprint_effect). 98 Cryptid items stay blocked; see README.txt.
name: Cryptid Pack
